name: experience-signature-backfill-cmd
title: Experience Layer: signature_backfill command (persist real signatures into live findings)
description: Add a signature_backfill CLI that writes the committed real semantic signatures (the LLM-assigned area|failureMode map produced by the offline backfill, e.g. lattice-Paper/backfill_signatures.json) into the live findings, filling each finding's empty signatureTag with signatureTagSource='backfill'. This turns the offline learnability evidence (62% held-out specific recurrence) into a live experience base so learning_scan derives real signals and learning_effectiveness/hints operate on real classes. The command does NOT call any LLM (it consumes the auditable committed map — deterministic). Audit-only and _hash-safe: signatureTag + signatureTagSource are excluded from the finding _hash (per the Phase 1b/3.2 invariant), so this mass write must keep every touched finding's _hash byte-identical; only EMPTY tags are filled (confirmed reviewer tags are never overwritten); idempotent; dry-run is the default and --apply is required to write.
